Your mission is to research, source, and launch the coolest tech gadgets and smart lifestyle accessories that our millions of daily users will love.

Alibaba, 1688, Taobao

Collaborate with the marketing and development teams to design strategic placement funnels on Streetdirectory.com, converting navigation utility into lifestyle shopping traffic.

Analyze sales data, traffic patterns, and conversion rates to continuously refine product selection, pricing strategies, and storefront "stickiness."
